content.text: I fixed it with a one-line change in `lib/adapters/http.js:474`. The Node `http` adapter now lowercases the `content-encoding` value before matching it against `gzip`, `x-gzip`, `compress`, `deflate` and `br`. So responses sent with `GZIP`, `Gzip` and similar, like the ones from storage.googleapis.com, now get decompressed. I haven't run any tests or tried it against a real non-lowercase response.
